aiDescriptions.n: Tableau Agent drafts descriptions for data sources, workbooks and tables in Catalog (Cloud). Tableau Next has a Beta generator.

bulkMetadata.n: REST methods: Update Column, Batch Add Tags, and from API 3.30 field descriptions on a work copy. These methods need Data Management.

autoClassify.n: Users set sensitivity labels and tags by hand or via REST. The docs show no automatic column classification.

sampleValues.n: Tableau Agent sends up to 1000 unique sampled values from the data source to the model when users author vizzes.

queryHistory.n: No feature mines usage or query logs to suggest models or metrics. Tableau Agent drafts descriptions from the data source.

lineage.n: Catalog lineage filters to a selected field or column, upstream or downstream. Custom SQL tables have no columns. Cubes are unsupported.

evals.n: Q&A Calibration (Beta) in Tableau Next tests questions in Concierge. Then users verify and calibrate the results.

vendors.enrichHowTo: With a Data Management license, call Update Column to set one column description at a time. Or use the REST API 3.30 data source methods. These methods create a work copy. Add FieldDescription and TableDescription elements to it, then publish it. Batch Add Tags tags many assets in one call. In Tableau Next, turn on the Semantic Description Generator (Beta). Review each draft.

Step 4: Enable Tableau Next AI Features

aiDescriptions.n: SpotterModel drafts column descriptions from a chat prompt. Autonomous build is Beta. AI synonyms are Early Access.

bulkMetadata.n: The TML API exports and imports Model TML in bulk, with column descriptions and synonyms. Column property sync is Early Access.

autoClassify.n: The docs show no automatic PII tagging. The docs advise users to exclude PII columns from indexing by hand.

sampleValues.n: Indexing samples 1,000 values per column. It powers Spotter value suggestions and column sample values. Secure suggestions fetch values live.

queryHistory.n: No feature builds models or examples from warehouse query logs. Memory comes from Liveboards and conversations (Early Access).

lineage.n: Tables list dependent Models, Liveboards and Answers and the columns they use. DataHub builds column lineage.

evals.n: Add to Coaching saves verified question and answer pairs. The Spotter Conversations Liveboard shows feedback. The docs show no benchmark runner.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Export the Model as TML with the TML API. Edit column descriptions, synonyms and AI context in the file. Then import it back with the import API. Use Generate under Spotter optimization to draft AI context per column. Review it. Use the Spotter diagnose prompts to find confusing columns.

bulkSnippet.code:
{
 "metadata_tmls": [
 "guid: <model_guid>
model:
  name: <model_name>
  columns:
  - name: <column_name_1>
    description: <column_description>
    properties:
      synonyms:
      - <synonym>
"
 ],
 "import_policy": "PARTIAL",
 "create_new": false
}

aiDescriptions.n: The docs show no description generator. The Assistant index builds its own descriptions from column names. It does not write them back.

bulkMetadata.n: The Data model spec API replaces whole models as JSON or YAML, with column descriptions. dbt persist_docs also feeds them.

autoClassify.n: The docs show no automatic column classification. Users set column-level security rules by hand.

sampleValues.n: The docs describe the Assistant index as built from names, descriptions and generated synonyms. The docs describe no sampled values.

queryHistory.n: Usage dashboards report query statistics for admins. No feature turns them into models or examples.

lineage.n: The lineage graph and lineage API are element level: tables, joins, charts, controls. The docs do not describe column-level lineage.

evals.n: Agent evaluation suites run from input tables or the REST API, using AI_USAGE records. The Assistant has response feedback.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Get the data model with GET /v2/dataModels/{id}/spec. Edit table, column and metric descriptions in the JSON or YAML. Then send the full spec back with PUT /v2/dataModels/{id}/spec. The API does not support partial updates. Warehouse comments or dbt with persist_docs can also supply descriptions. Add AI context (Beta) for Assistant instructions.

aiDescriptions.n: The docs show no AI description generator. Users write synonyms, column context and DataSet context in AI Readiness by hand.

bulkMetadata.n: An API sets DataSet description and tags. Users edit column descriptions per DataSet in the UI or sync them from Snowflake.

autoClassify.n: The docs show no column classification. PII Vault, a partner product with Anonomatic, redacts PII at upload.

sampleValues.n: AI Readiness uses descriptions, synonyms and column context that you write. The docs describe no value sampling. The Beast Mode assistant sends only schema.

queryHistory.n: Activity Log records usage for admins. No feature mines it to suggest models or examples.

lineage.n: Native lineage is DataSet, DataFlow, card and alert level. The Domo site lists a column-level lineage agent app.

evals.n: The docs show no eval set tooling. AI Playground tests prompts against a DataSet. AI Chat has a feedback option.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Open the AI Readiness tab on each DataSet. Add DataSet context, synonyms and column context. Switch on AI Enabled for the columns that Domo AI should use. If column descriptions live in Snowflake, ask your Domo account team to turn on Schema tab metadata sync. Governance Toolkit Tag Management jobs apply tags to many DataSets at once.

aiDescriptions.n: Ask Metabot in chat to write descriptions. It sees only database content, so it cannot supply business context.

bulkMetadata.n: No native bulk edit exists. Scripts call PUT /api/table/{id} and PUT /api/field/{id}. The community dbt-metabase package does this from dbt.

autoClassify.n: Sync and fingerprinting assign semantic types to columns automatically. The docs show no PII or sensitivity tagging.

sampleValues.n: Metabase sends sampled field values to the AI. So Metabot can check if a state is WI or Wisconsin.

queryHistory.n: Metabot keeps only the current conversation. Nothing mines past queries to suggest models or examples.

lineage.n: The dependency graph links questions, models, metrics, dashboards, transforms and their source tables. The docs describe no column-level lineage.

evals.n: Thumbs feedback on Metabot answers goes to Metabase, not into verified examples. The docs show no eval set tooling.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Edit table and field descriptions in Data Studio, Connected data. Ask Metabot to draft them. To write descriptions at scale, run a script or the dbt-metabase package after each dbt run. Call PUT /api/table/{id} and PUT /api/field/{id}. Define business terms in the Glossary. Metabot reads the Glossary.

aiDescriptions.n: The docs show no built-in AI description feature. The MCP service added in 6.1 lets an external agent work with Superset.

bulkMetadata.n: superset export_datasources and import_datasources move datasets as YAML, with column and metric descriptions. The docs are for Superset Next.

autoClassify.n: The README feature list shows no automatic column classification.

sampleValues.n: The docs and 6.1 notes show no built-in NL-to-SQL, so no value matching exists. MCP clients bring their own model.

queryHistory.n: The README and MCP docs show no feature that mines query history to suggest joins, metrics or examples.

lineage.n: Dataset related-objects lists the charts and dashboards that use a dataset. The docs show no column-level lineage.

evals.n: Superset has no NL-to-SQL feature, so it has no eval tooling.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Export datasets with superset export_datasources. Edit the column and metric description fields in the YAML. Import them back with superset import_datasources. The REST API offers the same data model. Superset has no AI description feature. So draft descriptions elsewhere and load them this way.

bulkSnippet.code:
superset export_datasources -f datasources.zip
# edit column descriptions in the exported YAML, then rezip
superset import_datasources -p datasources.zip

notes.text: The page for AI context on data models says it describes public beta features. These features may change. Sigma datasets are no longer a data source since 2026-09-15. Use data models.
